name: Superconduction / death

request.text: 4-second dry close game SFX. Immediate loud attack. A thin high cold metallic singing whistle sweeping downward through fine crystalline fractures, with needle-like electrical fizz and a lingering icy harmonic tail. Audible evolving tail for 3 seconds; fade only at end. No voice, scream, music, ambience or reverb.
